text: We have our final A5 interview in November (interview + center of life) after 4 years on A5. The MH clerk told us that we would then, at the time of the meeting, have to state whether we wish to go for the residency or the citizenship. On the AIC website I've read that one could apply for citizenship 3 months before those 4 years are over, but how does one go about if one wants to apply for permanent residency? Can/should this also be done before the 4 years are over (which, in our case, would also be 3 months before the final A5 interview)?
